name: invoiceninja-mcp-server
description: MCP server for self-hosted Invoice Ninja v5 instances.
long_description: Connect Claude to your self-hosted [Invoice Ninja](https://invoiceninja.com) v5 instance. 379 API endpoints (invoices, clients, payments, quotes, expenses, reports, and more) behind 3 catalog-backed tools. Reads execute freely; mutating endpoints require explicit per-call authorization and are backed up before execution.

base_url.title: Invoice Ninja Base URL
base_url.description: Your Invoice Ninja v5 instance URL, no trailing slash, no /api/v1, for example https://invoicing.yourdomain.com

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Create one in Invoice Ninja under Settings > Account Management > Integrations > API tokens

timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: HTTP timeout for Invoice Ninja API requests, minimum 1000

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List/filter all 379 endpoints by category, read-vs-mutating, or search term

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Full spec for one endpoint: method, path, params, body fields, mutating flag

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Execute an endpoint; mutating calls need per-call authorization and are backed up first
